thread:
alex_kapoor: Hi team — need an urgent routing for an EU hire offer. Candidate Luca Moretti (DE) is asking to have medical benefits effective day 1 and a provisional pension waiver for the first 6 months while payroll transition completes. Start date target: 2026-04-20. Do we have a fast-path for approvals?

sophia_hr: @alex_kapoor thanks — we can do provisional waivers but need Benefits + Legal + Finance signoff. Can you confirm comp band and whether salary needs a geo adj? Also need the signed offer PDF.

tara_recruiter: Candidate accepted verbally. Offer ID 987654. Comp band S3 (senior engineer), salary as listed in offer. Attached signed offer in email thread. Visa is already approved, no relocation.

james_fin: Quick flag — pension waiver affects employer social contributions. Finance needs the payroll code and whether this will be 'deferred employer contribution' or 'waive entirely' for first 6 months. Also need headcount approver (mgr) in CC.

alex_kapoor: Manager is @maria.chen (already on the offer). If benefits team approves day-1 medical and Legal ok's waiver, Finance can retro-run contributions?

legal_ops: We can approve a provisional waiver but need the candidate to sign the localized waiver doc. Also need to confirm this doesn't violate German statutory minimums. Send the localized doc: "DE-Pension-Waiver-v1".

sophia_hr: Routing plan: 1) Benefits review day-1 medical (medical plan enrollment code: MED-EU-STD) 2) Legal review waiver doc 3) Finance sign for payroll handling 4) People Ops final signoff for exception. I will start the routing now.

hr-bot: Automated checklist created: /checklist start offer-987654. Status: benefits_pending, legal_pending, finance_pending.

alex_kapoor: Dropping the candidate timeline: start 2026-04-20, needs benefits active 2026-04-20, pension waiver through 2026-10-19. Please escalate if any blockers.

james_fin: Can we avoid retro payroll if we set effective date as 04-20 and create a temporary payroll entry? If Benefits agrees to manual enrollment on day 1 we can set payroll flag TEMP-WAIVE and reconcile at month end. I need written Legal approval first.

legal_ops: Reviewed localized waiver. Comments inline: must include explicit acknowledgement that employee retains statutory rights and waiver is time-limited. Added clause. Updated doc attached.

sophia_hr: @james_fin @legal_ops I've attached signed candidate acknowledgement and updated waiver. Benefits confirmed MED-EU-STD can be activated day-1. Please confirm Finance and People Ops if we can route for final exec signature.

james_fin: Finance ok on TEMP-WAIVE approach. Please route final approval.

sophia_hr: Routing to exec approvers now: /approve-offer --id 987654 --candidate "Luca Moretti" --compband=S3 --pension_waiver=provisional --benefits_effective=2026-04-20

alex_kapoor: Thanks all. If exec sign happens today we can complete onboarding tasks and schedule payroll handoff. :thumbsup:

hr-bot: Approval requested from: maria.chen, vp-eng. Pending: vp-eng.

maria.chen: Approved. Good to go from manager side.

vp-eng: Approved.

hr-bot: Offer 987654 fully approved. Next steps: onboarding invite, payroll ticket (PR-4567), benefits enrollment scheduled for 2026-04-20.

alex_kapoor: Great — closing thread. Please file a short note in the hire packet about the provisional pension waiver and reconciliation plan.
